listing.summary: Upstream reports main menu with video/audio/controller input, plus training and first mission loading and gameplay. Online multiplayer is not implemented. steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own GoldenEye 007: Reloaded Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 415608AF/media 40583A82.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract own GoldenEye Reloaded ISO, then use Clang/CMake; codegen runs during build.
